name: Fixed steel jacket platform
description: Bottom-founded tubular steel lattice that transfers deck, drilling and environmental loads to the seabed, normally via driven piles through the jacket legs.

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Fixed platform: fixed platforms economically feasible to about 500 ft (150 m); deeper usually floating or subsea tieback
Wikipedia Oil platform, Fixed platforms section: economically feasible up to about 520 m (1,710 ft)
Offshore Technology project profile: fixed processing platform supported by 7,400 t steel jacket; water depth 361 ft; 16 well slots
Offshore Technology: 180 m tall tubular jacket ~10,500 t; topsides 12,000 t; platform water depth 172 m; piles 3,150 t up to 120 m long

applications: Bottom-founded tubular steel lattice that transfers deck, drilling and environmental loads to the seabed, normally via driven piles through the jacket legs.
